description: 海岸保全施設データ [sediment-control and coastal defences] is a dataset listed in National Land Numerical Information (国土数値情報) download site of MLIT, Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by 国土交通省. 海岸法第二条において定義される海岸保全施設である海岸保全区域内にある堤防、突堤、護岸、胸壁、離岸堤、砂浜（海岸管理者が消波等の海岸を防護する機能を維持するために設けたもので、指定したものに限る）、その他海水の侵入又は海水による侵食を防止するための施設について、GISデータとして整備したものです。. Coverage: Japan. The portal files it under the publisher 国土交通省. It offers 1 resource(s) in shp, geojson. The portal shows 2012-12-31 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is non-commercial use only under the download site terms. Caveats: this record was written from the product page on the download site (title, description where given, licence, formats and dates), so the data files were not opened, their contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-japan-mlit-national-land-numerical-information.
